comment: Independent C-first earthquake-drum confirmation after the first corrected-slot recording stopped at `--More--` before C reached the heavy shaking message or do_earthquake RNG. This recipe uses a new seed and clock, dismisses any startup page, selects the C-observed drum slot e, and supplies six spaces after the play action to continue the source messages and inspect any pit creation. It targets music.c:do_play_instrument(DRUM_OF_EARTHQUAKE) -> do_improvisation -> do_earthquake; record the complete observed source boundary and any later pager stop.
